comment: I thought that there's no inherent connection between protein content and the health level of product. So having high protein content and grade A is neither consistent nor inconsistent for me. I have seen them as two different dimensions. So none of the answers appeared right to me. I ended up selecting "somewhat". High in protein doesn't confirm nor deny that there are also unhealthy additives.
I only buy packaged foods once per week but that's because I only shop once per week. Maybe you should have asked how often I use/consume packaged foods. That's 7 days per week.

last question had a likert scale where 'slightly' was used as lower than 'somewhat' (i.e. slightly=2, somewhat=3/neutral) etc. That seems a bit off, and using such terms/words without a number for the scale may influence your results because they are quite subjective / based on your own views.
